title: GeometryAuthority
description:
The authority side of the two-sided geometry proof: a snapshot binding a Figma node's DECIDED values (fetched via REST, out of band, saved as a capture file) to the artefact reading in force when the comparison ran.

A ledger under VDS S-4(2). The proof never re-derives the agreement - that would need the values - it verifies the BINDING: both input hashes must still match what is on disk, or the snapshot is STALE, visibly, and proves nothing (draft S-7A(5)).

capture.description: The saved REST capture the authority side was read from, repository-relative. It holds realisations, so it lives in the project tree and NEVER under `.vds/` (VDS S-2(2)).

captureDigest.description: Digest of the capture file at comparison time: the AUTHORITY side's input hash. The capture moving on disk stales this snapshot.

contentDigest.description: A digest over every other field, for the reason the reading carries one: this snapshot is the proof's only record of the comparison.

fetchedAt.description: When the authority values were FETCHED from the design file's API. The fetch date is part of the claim: an old capture is an old decision.

nodeId.description: The node the authority values were read from, `12:34` spelling.

readingDigest.description: The geometry reading's content digest at comparison time: the ARTEFACT side's input hash. The reading regenerating stales this snapshot.

AuthorityAgreement.description:
One surface kind's agreement between the authority and the artefact.

An AGREEMENT BIT and never a value, per the S-2(7) pin amendment: a Figma `cornerRadius` is a realisation and has no field to live in here. The generator that compared the two sides holds the values; this row holds only whether they agreed and where to look when they did not.

agrees.description: Whether the authority reading and the artefact reading agree for this kind, as the out-of-band comparator found them.

because.description: Where the disagreement lives, in the comparator's words. Required by the proof when `agrees` is false: a bare bit names no work.

SurfaceKind.description:
The shapes a bound may be declared over. CLOSED, and closed on purpose.

VDS S-7A(3): the bound is per SURFACE KIND and never one number for the estate. The subscriber project's instrument reported "561 hand-rolled card-geometry containers, pin 561", and that number names no work: it cannot be assigned to anybody, it cannot be finished, and it hides which shapes are worst. An enum rather than a free string is the strongest available form of that rule, because one undifferentiated bucket is then unrepresentable rather than merely discouraged.

oneOf.description: The weight of a surface's boundary: a border, a ring, a divider.
Control density: the spacing step a surface sets its own padding and gaps from.
Type scale: the size and leading step a surface sets its text from.

Timestamp.description: UTC, second resolution, trailing Z. The one canonical form VDS writes.
